hotel.name: The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort rises 27 stories over Collins Avenue and a white-sand beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rising 27 stories over fashionable Collins Ave and a brilliant white-sand beach

verified_facts.text: Bal Harbour sits at the northern tip of Miami Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: An oasis of pampering and privilege at the northern tip of Miami Beach, FL, Bal Harbour is one of the most distinguished addresses in South Florida

verified_facts.text: The Bal Harbour Shops are directly across Collins Avenue from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located near the hotel, directly across Collins Avenue, these luxury shops serve as an international destination

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on nine acres of oceanfront property and was designed by Sieger Suarez Architectural Partnership.
verified_facts.excerpt: situated on nine acres of stunning oceanfront property and designed by Sieger Suarez Architectural Partnership

verified_facts.text: The interiors are by Yabu Pushelberg and pay homage to Miami's Art Deco style.
verified_facts.excerpt: with interiors by world-renowned Yabu Pushelberg that pays homage to Miami’s Art Deco style

verified_facts.text: A silver cloud sculpture by Inigo Manglano-Ovalle, Cloud Prototype No. 4, hangs from the ceiling at the arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inigo Manglano-Ovalle’s “Cloud Prototype No. 4”, a captivating silver cloud sculpture suspended from the ceiling

verified_facts.text: All rooms have balconies with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our beachfront accommodations in Miami Beach have balconies with sweeping ocean views

verified_facts.text: Marble bathrooms have walk-in dual-head rainforest showers and separate soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Five-fixture marble baths feature walk-in, dual-head rainforest showers and separate soaking tubs

verified_facts.text: Suite guests have St. Regis Butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay in 1- and 2-bedroom oceanfront suites in Miami Beach with St. Regis Butler service

verified_facts.text: The eight-bedroom Grand Palace Suite on the 23rd floor is the largest suite at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accessible via a private hallway on the hotel’s 23rd floor, the Grand Palace Suite is the largest suite offering at the resort with 8-bedrooms

verified_facts.text: Atlantikos serves Mediterranean dishes in a blue-and-white setting reminiscent of Greece.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a color scheme reminiscent of the iconic blue and white hues of Greece, our oceanfront hotel restaurant in Miami Beach, Atlantikós, presents an exquisite array of Mediterranean dishes

verified_facts.text: La Gourmandise serves the St. Regis Afternoon Tea, which requires a 24-hour advance reservation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the classic St. Regis Afternoon Tea ritual (requires a 24-hr advance reservation).

verified_facts.text: BH Prime is the resort's steakhouse, using locally sourced seasonal ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring locally sourced seasonal ingredients, discover timeless steakhouse dishes blended with subtle global influences.

verified_facts.text: A champagne sabering ceremony is performed nightly at 6 pm at the St. Regis Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: the art of sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals series and is performed nightly at 6:00 pm at our luxury Miami bar

verified_facts.text: The resort's own Bal Harbour Bloody Sunrise is a local take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Bal Harbour Bloody Sunrise, a unique recipe created exclusively for The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort

verified_facts.text: Live music plays at the St. Regis Bar on Thursday, Friday and Saturday evenings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live music can be enjoyed on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday starting at 7pm

verified_facts.text: The Spa at St. Regis covers 14,000 square feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: 14,000 square feet of indulgence at The Spa at St. Regis

verified_facts.text: The Oceanfront Day Villas are 600-square-foot air-conditioned villas with a private indoor lounge and a full bathroom and shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in the luxury of a 600-square-foot air-conditioned Bal Harbour Oceanfront Day Villas, featuring a private indoor lounge area with full bathroom and shower

verified_facts.text: The resort's beach is 1,000 feet long.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step onto the magnificent 1,000-foot beach, just a few strides from your luxurious retreat.

verified_facts.text: Opera Gallery shows modern and contemporary art at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opera Gallery showcases an extraordinary collection of Modern and Contemporary Art at the St. Regis
